subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should builtin memory chunking add heading-aware behavior as the default, an opt-in strategy/config, or defer that capability to QMD/Memory Wiki/plugin paths while entity extraction stays separate?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the right fix changes memory index boundaries and may add config or model-call surfaces, and the entity-extraction portion crosses active memory, Memory Wiki, and plugin ownership.

options.title: Approve Narrow Builtin Chunking
options.body: Implement heading-aware section splitting in the builtin memory indexer with explicit reindex metadata and tests, while deferring entity extraction to a separate design track.

options.title: Add Opt-In Strategy Surface
options.body: Introduce a small supported chunking strategy config after API, docs, and upgrade review so existing users keep fixed-size behavior until they opt in.

options.title: Defer To Plugins Or QMD
options.body: Keep builtin memory fixed-size and route section-aware or graph memory experiments to QMD, Memory Wiki, or ClawHub/plugin implementations.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Builtin Chunking
recommendation.body: Implement heading-aware section splitting in the builtin memory indexer with explicit reindex metadata and tests, while deferring entity extraction to a separate design track.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest concrete history on the fixed chunker, SDK move, and memory-host boundary that would own a heading-aware chunking change.
